defs.pdo: PDO: shooting % plus save %, ×100. Around 100 is normal; far above or below usually means luck that fades.
defs.sh: Shooting %: goals per shot on goal.
defs.sfp: Shot share: the team's share of all shots on goal in its games.
defs.splits: season; l5 / l10 = last 5 / 10 games; home / away; last = last season.
defs.players: Key players: the 6 forwards and 3 defensemen with the most ice time over the team's last 5 games, plus the projected starting goalie.
defs.goalie: Starting goalies come from the starting-goalie page the scheduled run read; others are projected.
defs.prior: A skater's shooting % gets pulled toward last season's, itself pulled toward the position average over 200 shots.
defs.goals: Team goals use final scores, so a shootout win counts as one goal.
